report.summary:
I made the bounded accounting repair. The failing evidence is admitted Testing Result `dc18…` (`result://abiogenesis/dc18e35706b7e7e29bbb4332e219840c9bf03e9d6613222319d129d2aae1b388`, command observation `f84e10ea…`). `sbt test` exited 1. The accounting XML report (`d872e8b2…`) shows tests 5, failures 3: UAT-ACCT-NEG at spec line 113 reports `Balanced(PartitionTotals(5, 4, 0))` where `Unbalanced(…, 1)` is expected. UAT-ACCT-BND at line 122 reports `Balanced(PartitionTotals(1, 0, 0))` where `Unbalanced(…, 1)` is expected. UAT-ACCT-INV at line 145 gives `true did not equal false (5,4,0)`.

Cause: `AccountingVerifier.verify` tested `sum.difference >= 0L`, so any surplus of input over output plus error sink counted as Balanced. The governing design says `Balanced` holds iff `difference == 0` (module-design §5.5, implementation-design §5.6).

Fix: I changed one line in `build_tenants/scala_spark/cdme-accounting/src/main/scala/com/cdme/accounting/AccountingVerifier.scala` (L40) from `>= 0L` to `== 0L`. The comparison is exact `Long` equality with no tolerance. File sha256 went from `7ff8d8b73d7a…8e9c` to `56c2c1a1…a470b`, which matches the designed bytes recorded in the test design (L32) and the repair schedule (row M7). `totals` already sums per partition with `foldLeft`, so it does not depend on entry order. No change was made to the public API, the cdme-core DTOs, the engine call site, Spark `count()` in `ledgerOf`, the module structure or the build files. No test was changed: the spec matches the design and has no defect.

Afterwards, all 22 subject files match the schedule's table (checked with `shasum -c`). I wrote `repair/component-repair-application.md`, replacing the predecessor `e4acccfb…`. It cites `dc18…`, records the diff, digests and a static reading of every spec literal (labelled as a reading, not execution), and lists open items.

I ran no sbt, scalac or Testing command, created no `target/` directory or scratch files, and claim no passing result. Outside the worksite I read one file, read-only: the archived accounting XML report under `resources/archives/worksite-command-execution/…`, whose digest matched the admitted one. No archive, release, depth, mutation, result or qualification file was written.
